annotation.title_clean: AI for the Good of All: Brazilian Artificial Intelligence Plan (PBIA)
annotation.title_en: AI for the Good of All: Brazilian Artificial Intelligence Plan (PBIA)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MCTI); Center for Strategic Studies and Management (CGEE)
annotation.summary_en: Brazil's national AI plan (PBIA) commits R$23 billion for 2024–2028 across immediate-impact actions and five axes: infrastructure, training, public services, business innovation, and regulatory/governance support. It promotes human-centred, sovereign, sustainable, transparent AI. Robotics and physical AI are not substantively addressed.
key_provisions_or_claims: R$23.03 billion investment 2024–2028, with 59.9% for AI in business innovation
Five pillars of 'AI for the Good of All': human-centred, sustainable, sovereign, transparent, globally cooperative
Axis 5 supports AI regulatory framework (Bill 2338/23), a national center for algorithmic transparency and the Brazilian AI Observatory
Plan governance coordinated by the Interministerial Committee for Digital Transformation (CIT Digital)
Sovereign cloud and national supercomputing infrastructure; Portuguese-language LLMs
